question: What limitation of existing multimodal reasoning evaluations does VisuLogic identify?
expected_answer_summary: They rely on text descriptions and allow language-based reasoning shortcuts.
actual_output: VisuLogic identifies that existing multimodal reasoning evaluations often rely on text descriptions and permit language-based reasoning shortcuts, thereby failing to assess genuine vision-centric reasoning [S1, S4, S6]. Specifically, existing evaluations conflate text-based reasoning with visual reasoning and attribute language-driven results to visual reasoning, producing a misleading assessment of multimodal models' actual visual reasoning capabilities [S1, S5].
